findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The Claude path may intentionally allow a second Stop to retry a killer spawn that failed; but arm() runs before spawn in every adapter and no document names that behavior.
findingDetails.case: A Claude session emits Stop; the first killer arms the record but has not fired; the session emits a second Stop while the record is still armed, so arm() returns the already-armed record and spawnKiller runs again.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether arm() rejects a non-pending record or whether the Claude path deliberately retries spawn after a failed spawn; arm() returns the armed record and every sibling filters pending, so the retry explanation does not hold for the shared design.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Close if the Claude Stop hook provably fires at most once per loop, or if the already-armed branch is documented and tested as a spawn-retry path.
findingDetails.evidence: Claude checks only record.sessionId at :90 and calls arm() at :122. arm() returns the existing armed record unchanged at relaunch-core.cjs:309, so armed.status === armed passes the :122 check and :125 spawns a second killer. Codex :139-144, Hermes :100-104, Pi :353-357 and OpenCode :351-356 all require pending before arming; codex-adapters.test.cjs:316 asserts the already-armed case is ignored.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the same record.status !== pending guard used by the four sibling adapters before arm(), and add a claude-adapters test mirroring codex-adapters.test.cjs:316.
